sections.means: Both crops lost yield and grain protein when half the nitrogen was replaced by nano urea sprays.
sections.todo: Treat grain protein as a required outcome in any substitution trial before the protocol is promoted again.

sections.h2: IFFCO's own funded trial also found a 16–19% yield penalty at half nitrogen

chart.title: Both trials show yield losses of 13 to 19 per cent at half nitrogen
chart.sub: Yield loss against the 100% recommended nitrogen dose, %.

sections.means: The manufacturer's own funded trial reaches the same 16–19% yield penalty at 50% nitrogen as the university trial.
sections.todo: Confirm whether a 25% substitution holds yield outside the two rice sites tested before any higher dose is allowed.

sections.h2: The Fertiliser Control Order halved the nano dose to 25% in March 2026
